probe: one plugin, unforced output styles: are they selectable?
method: Throwaway probe plugins under the scratchpad, loaded with --plugin-dir; never in dist/. Each style body instructs the model to emit a canary token first. Prompt: '한국의 수도는 어디입니까?'. User settings carry no outputStyle.

runs.reply_head:
한국의 수도는 **서울**입니다.

- **공식 명칭**: 서울특별시
- **인구**: 약 940만 명 (수도권 전체로는 약 2,600만 명)
- **위치**: 한반도 중서부, 한강 유역

참고로 행정 기능 일부는

한국의 수도는 **서울**입니다.

참고로 "한국"을 대한민국(남한)으로 보면 수도는 서울특별시이고, 북한(조선민주주의인민공화국)의 수도는 평양입니다.

findings: Unforced plugin output styles ARE selectable. B and E: two styles in ONE plugin each applied when selected, each showing only its own canary.
P3's 'formal-report unreachable' holds only while another style is forced. Remove force-for-plugin and both profiles are reachable from one plugin.

The namespaced name is required. C: bare 'formal-report' did not resolve; 'ko-quality:formal-report' did. P3 recorded both forms as 'accepted', but a forced style won in every P3 run, so the forms were never distinguished.
The cost is that install alone does nothing. A: no style applied with no setting, which breaks 06 §1 'a tool that is used once installed'.
Not observed: switching mid-session via /output-style. Headless cannot reproduce it. Selection by setting is shown; the interactive path is inferred, not measured.
/output-style switches the style mid-session and the next turn obeys it: F turn 1 default and no canary, turn 2 the command, turn 3 CANARY-FORMAL.
It switches back and persists across processes: G started in the same cwd with no setting on the command line, replied CANARY-FORMAL, then switched to agent-reply and replied CANARY-AGENTREPLY.
The choice is stored per project, in <project>/.claude/settings.local.json. User settings were untouched. So an unforced design makes the profile a per-project choice, where today it is per install.

This does not contradict P3. P3 found init.output_style echoes the configured value, not the style in effect; here configured and effective agree because nothing is forced. A side effect: without forcing, that field becomes usable as evidence again (P7 injection_point).

interactive_probe.question: Does /output-style switch the style mid-session, and where is the choice stored?
interactive_probe.method: Multi-turn through --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json, one process per file, same cwd, --plugin-dir on the unforced probe plugin. ~/.claude/settings.json was snapshotted before the run and compared after.
